blogs.title: When Angioedema Isn't Angioedema: Recognizing the Masquerade of Dermatomyositis
blogs.description: This post explores the diagnostic challenge of neck swelling that mimics idiopathic angioedema. It discusses why clinicians should maintain a broad differential for 'pseudoangioedema' and highlights the critical transition from an ENT-led workup to an immunological one when histaminergic or bradykinin-mediated pathways are ruled out.

blogs.title: Look Closer at the Nails: Identifying Subtle Clues of Inflammatory Myopathy
blogs.description: While the heliotrope rash and Gottron’s papules are classic markers of dermatomyositis, they are not always present. This post teaches clinicians how to identify subtle physical exam findings—such as periungual telangiectasias, nailfold capillaroscopy microhemorrhages, and the Holster sign—that can point toward systemic myositis in patients with atypical presentations.

blogs.title: The Diagnostic Pivot: Why 'Mystery' Swelling Demands a Creatine Kinase Level
blogs.description: In this case, a simple CK level was the turning point in a complex diagnostic workup. This blog post discusses the clinical reasoning for ordering CK in patients with unexplained soft tissue edema or proximal weakness and how identifying significantly elevated muscle enzymes can redirect the clinical pathway toward autoimmune inflammatory myopathies.

blogs.title: Dysphagia and the Danger of Aspiration: Managing the Respiratory Risks of Myositis
blogs.description: Dermatomyositis can lead to severe pharyngeal dysphagia and subsequent aspiration pneumonitis. This post covers the management of airway-related complications, the necessity of nutritional support (NG tubes) during acute inflammatory phases, and how to monitor for pulmonary involvement in patients with significant muscle inflammation.

blogs.title: The Oncology Shadow: Risk Stratification and Screening in Dermatomyositis
blogs.description: Dermatomyositis is frequently associated with underlying malignancy. This post analyzes the IMACS guidelines for cancer screening in myositis patients, discussing how to calculate risk scores based on age, sex, antibody profiles (like anti-SAE1), and clinical features like dysphagia to ensure timely cancer detection.

blogs.title: Aggressive Immunosuppression: Navigating Treatment in Severe Inflammatory Myopathies
blogs.description: This blog post reviews the pharmacological management of severe dermatomyositis, including the role of high-dose pulse steroids, IVIG, and steroid-sparing agents like Rituximab and Mycophenolate Mofetil. It also considers the nuances of choosing medications in patients with concurrent pulmonary concerns.
